operator_decisions.layout: separate adapter rails_models (registry {rails, rails_models}, requires ruby); producer fingerprint key rails_models {adapter rails-models.v1, adapter_sha256, graph_producer_id, table_map_sha256}; manifest key rails_models format atlas-rails-models.v1; adapters combinable and separately replaceable
operator_decisions.table_targets: option B: model_table and migration_mentions are target-less EXTRACTED assertions carrying the table in canonical raw_target; tables are not graph entities; association targets class entities INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS/UNRESOLVED
operator_decisions.vocabulary: three relations only in ASSERTION_RELATIONS; one occurrence kind rails_model with role prefix rails_model:; fingerprint key == occurrence kind == relation set
operator_decisions.associations: receiverless direct class-body belongs_to/has_one/has_many in classes with base ApplicationRecord/ActiveRecord::Base/::ActiveRecord::Base under app/models/** (not concerns); literal class_name required; Rails compute_type candidate list restricted to indexed model classes; unique INFERRED, >=2 AMBIGUOUS ambiguous_class_name, target_not_model, class_not_found; every unsupported form UNRESOLVED unsupported_association with a closed construct code; no inflection
operator_decisions.tables: literal self.table_name or operator map atlas-rails-table-map.v1 via index --rails-table-map (bytes read by the caller, S31-style strict parse, typed errors before any write); conflicting_table_mapping, ambiguous_table_name, ambiguous_model, unsupported_table_name; unmatched keys counted in the manifest only
operator_decisions.migrations: db/migrate/*.rb only; ActiveRecord::Migration or ActiveRecord::Migration[d.d]; direct statements of def change/up/down; literal create_table/add_column/remove_column EXTRACTED; every other statement a closed unsupported_migration_op diagnostic; never proof of applied or live schema
operator_decisions.invalidation: probe-gated global purge and recompute on every build; rails_models ids join dropped; flag-gated bounded capture before every continue with MAX_FILES and declaration_limit
operator_decisions.provenance: occurrence span = declaration statement (class node for map facts) bound by the generation snapshot; map facts carry map_sha256
operator_decisions.no_execution: S24 spies plus sqlite3.connect/socket guards and AST ban; ASCII, iterative, no \d/\w/$
operator_decisions.churn: native producer/evidence/assertion/generation/snapshot id churn for all graphs accepted (S16/S21/S24 precedent); --frameworks rails route facts unchanged in substance (G-ROUTES)
